title: a second package for the same action is accepted: at-most-once is per package, not per action
note: Run from the repository root. Consumer state files start absent; delete *.state.json to rerun.

steps.label: accept A (log: A)
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P3/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P3/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P3/S.state.json

steps.label: accept B, same action (log: A,B), same state
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P3/B.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P3/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P3/S.state.json

steps.label: accept A again (log: A,B), same state
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P3/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P3/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P3/S.state.json
